notes.title: Realpolitiks 3 | Beta Version of New Patch is Here!
notes.content:
Greetings, fellow leaders!

We believe we have been able to identify the cause and fix the pesky bug causing save games to become corrupted. This will unfortunately not recover the non-functioning saves, and as with any update to Realpolitiks 3, we cannot guarantee it will be compatible with older saves at all.

Therefore, we have decided to put the updated version into a Beta version right now, so that those who want to try it out, can, and those who want to continue their current saved games, can do so without disturbance. 

To access the updated version, head to your Steam Library, right-click Realpolitiks 3: Earth and Beyond, left-click Properties, left-click Betas and from the drop-down menu select the option "beta - Upcoming Patch". Your game will then update and you can start playing.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110866/e2435eb81217e9f5ee0f4ebd6dccb9c3442ece0c.png

Please let us know if you encounter the save corrupting bug in the Beta version, or if it's smooth sailing for you. The best way to do that is by joining the "Realpolitiks HQ" Discord server, but of course, feel free to just comment on this announcement, or come to the Steam Discussions, we read your posts everywhere!

And if you come across any bug or technical issue, when reporting it be sure to describe the problem in detail, and include your save file and log file, which you can find here: C:\Users\%username%\AppData\LocalLow\Jujubee\RP3
(Simply archive all the contents of the folder and upload it to gdrive, wetransfer or any other file sharing service, and send us the link).

Happy Strategizing!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2298690/Realpolitiks_3_Earth_and_Beyond/

notes.title: Realpolitiks 3 | Critical Bugfixing Update is Live!
notes.content:
Greetings, fellow leaders!

We have just released a critical update, which fixes many of the issues you have been reporting since the game left Early Access. First and foremost, we are happy to report that not only will new saves not become corrupted anymore, but we have managed to implement fixes that ensure the ones affected by the bug are now playable again. If you find that this is not the case for you, please, contact us and send us the save files in question and we will try to recover them for you.

Besides bug fixes, we also improved game balance - most notably in the Stability system. Improving Stability will now be easier and faster, and Stability penalties caused by difference between the political affiliation of your country and your actions (for example if your society is largely conservative, but you push through liberal-leaning actions, or if you act as an autocrat in a heavily democratic society, etc.).

Full list of changes can be found below, but rest assured that we will continue to closely monitor your feedback and keep fixing bugs and generally improving the game. Please, if you encounter any issues or think of any suggestions for Realpolitiks 3, contact us on the Realpolitiks Discord server or here on Steam in the Discussions. We want to keep making your ruling experience as smooth and as enjoyable as possible.

Happy Strategizing!

Full Change Log:

 Fixed the corrupted saves issue - new ones should not break and old affected saves should be playable now - if not, please contact us
 Fixed a bug causing incorrect peace negotiations screen
 Fixed a bug which prevented players from capturing land from secondary enemies
 Fixed a bug causing projects and technologies to progress twice as fast as they should
 Fixed a bug causing countries the player has no pacts with to ask them to join a war
 Fixed a bug causing broken warscore
 Stability will now rise by 2 points every year
 Lowered the cooldown of the Invest in Stability action
 Increased the cooldown for Stabilization penalties
 Increased the amount of resources in provinces
 Increased income from Taxes
 Increased Destiny Points income
 Updated effects and costs of certain projects
 Updated conditions for war deceleration actions
 Added several missing localization texts
 Fixed the strategic point on Sao Tomo Island
 Various UI fixes

notes.title: Realpolitiks 3 | Development Continues - A Patch Is on Its Way
notes.content:
Greetings, fellow leaders!

As we've promised when we've released the latest hotfix, we are finalizing a patch that aims to fix many of the issues you've reported to us. We are sorry that serious bugs managed to sneak through our testing and spoiled the experience of so many of you at our full release - but we want to reassure you that we are working hard on another update and even with the Early Access period behind us, we will keep working to ensure that any aspiring world leader will be able to enjoy Realpolitiks 3 and have fun with the game.

The most important issues we are working on are the "corrupt saves" bug and the error preventing some players from negotiating with certain nations; but we are also looking into improving the balancing of the stability system to make drops in stability caused by the dissonance between your actions and your country's political affiliation more predictable and easily understandable, as well as many other smaller bugfixes and improvements (we will be looking at further improving the optimization too). Those changes might come in further, separate patches, as we are trying to release the critical-bug-fixing update as soon as possible.

We would also like to sincerely thank each and every one of our players who take the time to report the bugs and thus help us fix them. We understand how frustrating it is when a game bugs out; if you are one of those diehard fans who send us a detailed description of what happened to them, what they were doing ingame at the time, what their PC specs are (this is especially important when reporting problems with performance) and any other details they can remember, along with their logs and save files, please know that you are deeply appreciated and we are doing all we can to fix the problems you find. Thank you!

If you would also like to help us by reporting a bug you've found, the perfect place to do so is the Realpolitiks HQ Discord server. If you prefer Steam instead, you can use the discussion forum here as well. And if you are unsure how to deliver the logs and saves we mentioned, it's really easy - just upload all contents of the following folder to any file-sharing service such as gdrive or dropbox and send us the link: 
C:\Users\username\AppData\LocalLow\Jujubee\RP3

Thank you for staying with us. We will have news about our progress on the upcoming patch soon!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2298690/Realpolitiks_3_Earth_and_Beyond/

notes.title: Realpolitiks 3 | Hotfix is Live & More Fixes on the Way!
notes.content:
Greetings, fellow leaders!

Even though Realpolitiks 3: Earth and Beyond is now out of Early Access and fully released, we are still collecting feedback and bug reports from you and working on various fixes to the game. For now, we have put together a small patch, fixing several UI issues and problems related to certain language localizations.

However, we are also hard at work on the much bigger issues, notably the save-corrupting bug some of you have experienced; that in particular is our main priority, and it is actually tied in to several different problems, such as the bug preventing some players from negotiating peace treaties after wars with certain smaller nations. We hope to start testing an update with these fixes next week and get it released quickly.

We will continue to closely monitor your feedback, whether it's on the Realpolitiks Discord server or here on Steam, so please, keep reporting any bugs you find, and posting any suggestions that come to your mind - we'd like to keep supporting the game for as long as needed, fixing any issues that prevent you from enjoying ruling your country, and even rebalancing the game if necessary, based on what we learn from you.

Attaching logs and save files would be helpful as well – please send us everything you find in this folder:

C:\Users\%username%\AppData\LocalLow\Jujubee\RP3

Happy Strategizing!

First Post-Launch Hotfix Change Log:

 Province names in Chinese and Russian disappear and reappear correctly now
 Improved top-down unit view.
 UI fixes for languages other than English and Polish
 Minor localization fixes

notes.title: Realpolitiks 3: Earth and Beyond Leaves Early Access!
notes.content:
Greetings, fellow leaders!

The day has finally come, allow us to officially announce that Realpolitiks 3: Earth and Beyond leaves Early Access today and launches as a full game, being 20% off at launch.

[previewyoutube=gZJraraQprQ;full][/previewyoutube]

First of all, we'd like to start with a huge "thank you" to every single one of you for taking part in the Early Access journey, whether it was by purchasing the game, participating in the Open Beta, writing a review here on Steam or simply sharing your comments on the forums. It is you, our community, that helped us get through and shape the game.

Now to the full launch itself. The game features a whole host of new content and updates for its 1.0 launch today. These include:


 A new "Climate War" scenario, in which the world faces a wave of climate disasters, eventually leading to a new type of wars to emerge, with countries fighting for basic resources and survival.
 Finalized Leadership mechanic, letting players develop their Head of State and other members of the cabinet as they gain experience.
 Various quality of life features, improvements and bugfixes based on community feedback, including the Timeline review, in which players can see how successful their reign has been, new combat balancing and changes to trade functionality, among others.
 Localization to German, Spanish, French, Polish, Simplified Chinese and Russian languages.
 Option to utilise the cash reserves to purchase the main resources at market prices.


Besides that, we’ve implemented tons of fixes and changes, including updates of the difficulty levels. The full Change Log can be found below the article.

One thing that deserves your special attention is the video tutorial for the game – you can launch it either by following this link or in-game by clicking the first icon at the bottom of the screen, which then opens the video on YouTube in your browser.

DISCLAIMER: During the playtests, we've noticed a rare crash that can happen to some players when they start a new game, then go to the main menu and then change the language of the game. In case this crash happens to you, simply launch the game again and everything will work just fine.

The journey is still not over, though, we will be closely monitoring your feedback, whether it's on the Realpolitiks Discord server or here on Steam and we'd like to keep supporting the game for as long as needed, patching any bugs that may have slipped through our fingers and rebalancing the game, if necessary.

Don't forget that the game is also included in the REALPOLITIKS FRANCHISE bundle along with its older siblings where you can get an additional bundle discount.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/46403/Realpolitiks_Franchise_Bundle/

And to celebrate the full launch even more, the game is now included in two more bundles.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/53194/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/53196/

Thank you again for being a part of this journey with us!

Happy Strategizing!

notes.title: Open Beta is Open!
notes.content:
Greetings, fellow leaders!

The release date of the full version of Realpolitiks 3: Earth and Beyond (April 24) is getting closer every day and we've prepared something special for you.

Because we want the game to leave Early Access in as good and polished state as possible, we have just started an Open Beta of a version that contains most of the new content and features even before the full launch. We did our best to implement as much of our community's feedback as possible, but we would still like to know more, so that we can put final tweaks and polish on the game. We'll be closely monitoring any feedback and bug reports you post either here in the comments, in Steam Discussions or, preferably, on the Realpolitiks HQ Discord server; you can even contact the developers directly at contact@jujubee.pl - please don't be shy and share your thoughts with us!

This Open Beta will last until Monday, April 14. To access it, head to your Steam Library, right-click Realpolitiks 3: Earth and Beyond, left-click Properties, left-click Betas and from the drop-down menu select the option "Beta - public betatest in April". Your game will then update to the pre-final version. We can't wait to hear what you think!

Thank you very much for your engagement, we wouldn't have been able to get this far without you! And thank you for taking part in our Early Access journey in general!

The Jujubee Team

notes.title: Realpolitiks 3 | The Changing World Update is Out Now!
notes.content:
Greetings, fellow leaders!

We bring excellent news - we have just released the second of our planned Early Access Content Updates, dubbed "The Changing World.” As the name implies, it puts into your hands many tools and features allowing you to leave a mark on the Earth and other planets of our Solar system. For example, you will be able to liberate states, change the names of provinces and countries, move your capital and more!

You will also be able to tackle the challenges posed by the ever-changing world by using new tools, such as enacting Martial Law for an immediate boost to your countries stability and lowered dissent among population, and the ability to bypass the parliament when setting up projects and actions, but your relations with other nations will suffer and the dissatisfaction of your population will grow for as long as martial law is in effect. You will also be able to use your influence to help (or harm) the new Non-Governmental Organizations (NGO's), which can provide useful bonuses, but also penalties, if their views are not aligned with your doctrines.

As with most updates, we highly recommend starting a new campaign to enjoy the full range of new features, fixes and improvements, the list of which is available below. We can't wait to see what you think about the update, and how you will wield the new tools it places at your disposal!

Full Change Log
New features

 Martial law and party banning
 Liberation of states system
 NGO's
 Finalized features for playing as a block member
 Possibility to change the names of provinces, countries, etc. 
 Different ways to win: Technological Victory, Cultural Victory, Economic Victory, Diplomatic Victory, Military Victory
 Moving the capital
 Recreating historical countries
 New events and tasks
 New sounds
 New faces for the countries of the Arab civilization

Bug Fixes & Improvements

 Fixed bugs with AI block creation
 Fixed bugs with nukes
 Fixed bugs with wars
 Fixed bug with new countries not creating armies
 Planes can now be removed
 Fixed bug with unrealistically large migrations
 Fixed HDI projection problems
 Fixed detection of province neighbors and army pathfinding
 Fixed applying and removing effects when taking over provinces


Thank you for joining us on our Early Access journey, and helping us to improve the gameplay experience - if you encounter any issues or bugs, or just want to share your thoughts or suggestions, contact us either through the Realpolitiks HQ Discord, here on Steam or by email to contact@jujubee.pl.

If you are reporting a bug, be sure to describe the problem in detail, and include your save file and log file, which you can find here: C:\Users\%username%\AppData\LocalLow\Jujubee\RP3 
(Simply archive all the contents of the folder and upload it to gdrive, wetransfer or any other file sharing service, and send us the link).

Happy Strategizing!

notes.title: Realpolitiks 3 | Fire and Brimstone Update Out Now!
notes.content:
Greetings, fellow leaders!

With the Holiday season almost upon us, we would like to give all the Realpolitiks fans an early Christmas present - the first large Content Update for Realpolitiks 3: Earth and Beyond, which is currently in Early Access. We call it the "Fire and Brimstone" Update, since what better way to celebrate the Holidays than by scorching the planet with nuclear fire?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110866/f4fb64cf784926fa797fe71e3f4b0a26451688ec.gif

But of course, our game is all about the freedom to choose how you want to rule - if you want to treat the world as a garden rather than a battlefield, the update brings new options for enacting environmental policies. Perhaps you will be able to save the Earth, rather than destroy it - the choice is yours!

New Features

 Nuclear Weapons Mechanics: Manage, deploy, and respond to nuclear threats, introducing a new level of strategy to international conflicts.
 DEFCON System: Track global tension levels and make decisions that impact your nation’s readiness for war (or peace).
 Environmental Policies: Implement eco-friendly projects, manage pollution, and tackle global climate challenges to maintain a sustainable future.

Also as part of our seasonal celebration, we have decorated the main menu accordingly. Enjoy the Holiday mood, we will be taking the cosmic Christmas tree down shortly after New Year's, as is tradition!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110866/05cc0ee8bc7a6931d12f23c33f5cb9eafc3631ea.png

And of course, we do our best to improve the technical state of the game with each update, big or small, and squash the various bugs that crawl from their hiding places when you report them!

Bug Fixes and Technical Improvements

 Enabled the window of a given project to stay open after clicking on the maintenance cost of a project from the list in the economy overview window; also enabled the block window to stay open after clicking on the maintenance cost of a block
 Improved the differentiation between single-province and all-province effects (previously these descriptions were identical and it was not clear whether they were for one or all provinces)
 Added the ability to switch single-thread/multi-thread save mode in the game options

notes.content:
Greetings, fellow leaders!

Realpolitiks 3: Earth and Beyond has been in Early Access for a little over a day now, and thanks to your feedback, we've already prepared a patch fixing various bugs, improving the optimization, adding quality of life features and overall making parts of the game clearer to understand - the full Change Log can be found below. We would recommend starting a new campaign in order to make sure all fixes are applied properly and that you get the best possible gameplay experience.

Please continue giving us your feedback here in the comments, in the Steam discussions, or join the Realpolitiks HQ Discord - we need your input in order to make this the best grand strategy experience for you!

We are already working on a next patch, as we would like to release hotfixes similar to this one about once a week; while these are a priority right now and our focus is on fixing any technical issues and making the current content playable as smoothly as possible for you, we have plans for bigger updates throughout the Early Access period as well. Those will bring new features that will give you an even wider variety of tools for ruling your country, the world and the Solar system. Instead, it is focused on providing a fun gameplay experience, letting you lead a country in a modern setting and rule it however you choose. To keep each playthrough fresh, countries are partially randomized at the start of every campaign. While borders, political systems, and overall power stay the same, the starting stats and policies will be different each time, providing new challenges and opportunities. We have included this clarification at the start of the game and in its store description - it was never our intention to create any different expectations.

Greetings, fellow leaders!

Today we have some important news for you. We are thrilled to announce that Realpolitiks 3: Earth and Beyond will launch into Early Access on October 22!

As of the Early Access launch, you will be able to pick from a range of 195 countries, and strive for domination of not just the Earth, but the entire Solar System in three different game modes:

 Realism mode ties you to a world which runs very similarly to ours, with pacts dividing the world between several blocs (NATO, EU, etc.).
 Overdrive mode offers a freedom of experience with all stats cranked up to extreme. With old order being just a flimsy excuse for an all-out brawl between the strongest. This mode is the only one available in the demo that's live right now, we hope you will give it a try and let us know what you think!
 Sandbox mode lets you build up from the start and make any country your politician leads a success - and boy, is it a long and hard journey to the top.

A number of features and mechanics are already planned to be added during the Early Access period - with the final 1.0 launch expected to be released in the first half of 2025. These include the possibility to use weapons of mass destruction, implement martial law, the influence of pollution on the environment, different winning objectives for campaigns and much more - even overall different campaign scenarios and recreating historical countries. The developers are also planning to add more textual localizations to the game at full launch, including French, German, Spanish, Polish, Simplified Chinese and Russian. 

We will post a more detailed roadmap of our Early Access development at launch, but since we will rely heavily on your feedback, these are subject to change.

Thank you very much for supporting us, we can't wait to show you more! For now, enjoy the DEMO that's available for the Steam Next Fest period and keep sharing your thoughts with us - the best way to do that is joining the Realpolitiks HQ Discord server, where you can chat directly with the devs!

notes.title: Expanding the Horizons of Warfare in Realpolitiks 3: Earth and Beyond
notes.content:
Greetings, fellow leaders!

We’re thrilled to share one of the most groundbreaking changes coming to Realpolitiks 3 — an all-new, multi-layered combat system that brings the battlefield to unprecedented levels, from land to the stars! We know that in previous entries of the Realpolitiks series, warfare was primarily focused on land and sea combat. However, the geopolitical landscape has evolved, and so has the way battles are fought in our game. In Realpolitiks 3, players will engage in land, air, orbital, and planetary warfare, marking a significant leap forward in strategic complexity and immersion.

Before we get down to brass tacks, we have an important announcement to make - Realpolitiks 3: Earth and Beyond will be a part of Steam Next Fest with a playable demo starting Monday, October 14! Don’t forget to wishlist and follow the game now, we will bring you full details about the demo on Monday!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2298690/Realpolitiks_3_Earth_and_Beyond/

But now, let’s break down what’s new and what you can expect when leading your nation to victory across those new fronts.

1. Land Combat: The Foundation of Military Might

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110866/8e49c88a264b3fb899d0c0b75d6a3cd2f059493c.gif

While the scope of warfare has expanded, land battles continue to be a cornerstone of global conflicts. In Realpolitiks 3, we’ve completely overhauled the land combat system to introduce dynamic frontlines and battles across provinces. Instead of simply moving units between provinces as in previous games, you can now maneuver your military units across the entire world map, giving you the freedom to position them strategically in any location. This new system allows for more nuanced control of your forces, enabling players to create tactical advantages by forming dynamic frontlines and flanking maneuvers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110866/a09dac0d84b77cecfbf322f5bcf5f609474352e2.png

Additionally, combat is no longer restricted to individual provinces. You’ll now engage in extended battles along provinces, where multiple units clash over larger areas of territory, simulating real-world, multi-front warfare. The ability to pair your land forces with air support remains, allowing you to blend the boundaries between land and air combat for maximum effectiveness on the battlefield.
This new approach ensures a far more fluid and realistic war experience, where proper positioning and maintaining supply lines across various fronts will be key to achieving victory.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110866/7ed2dcb4f6c7ae0501f468dc1a6edd1a4a8c7d96.gif

2. Air Warfare: Dominating the Skies

Air power has become a pivotal force in modern conflicts, and in Realpolitiks 3, you’ll be able to build and deploy air units to gain aerial superiority. Control over the skies will directly affect your ability to defend against orbital strikes or intercept enemy aircraft before they can reach critical infrastructure.
With a focus on technological advancements, you can invest in different types of air units, from traditional fighter jets to next-gen stealth bombers and drones. Use your air force to support ground troops, engage in dogfights, or bombard enemy positions from the skies. This layer of warfare introduces new challenges, as success will require mastering the delicate balance of air and land superiority.

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110866/4e9f1d7fa477e3902dbb715b242c170c1ba1ea25.png[/td]
        [td]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110866/b5953bdc2648ea7f6d7ebad163ed911e58252d32.png[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

3. Orbital Warfare: The Battle Beyond Earth

In an era where space is no longer the final frontier, orbital combat plays a pivotal role in the geopolitical landscape of Realpolitiks 3. For the first time in the series, you’ll be able to engage in orbital warfare not only around Earth but also in the orbits of other celestial bodies, including the Moon, the Sun, and every planet in the Solar System. This brings a new level of depth to interplanetary warfare, where each celestial body's orbit becomes a potential battlefield for control over vital resources and strategic positions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110866/439afa2f64e4ade61a42422b4e2c7c9a876a0e7c.png

You can now deploy satellites, space stations, and defense platforms around any of these planets and moons. Whether defending Earth from orbital threats or expanding your presence in space to other planets, orbital warfare will require careful planning and technological superiority. Satellites can be used for espionage, gathering crucial intelligence on enemy movements across the solar system, while orbital lasers and kinetic weapons offer powerful tools for devastating attacks from space. Defensive platforms allow you to guard against enemy strikes and secure your presence in orbit, preventing other nations from gaining a technological or military edge.

This new system emphasizes that victory in space can cripple a nation’s infrastructure, cutting off communications or disabling satellites. But the stakes have risen even further: controlling the orbit of the Moon, Mars, or even the Sun provides significant geopolitical advantages, as nations with dominance in these orbits can strike across the entire solar system. Mastery of space warfare will not only protect your assets on Earth but also open new avenues for expansion and military supremacy across the stars.

This expanded orbital system ensures that space isn’t just an afterthought—it’s a core component of your global strategy, where dominance in orbit translates directly into control over the terrestrial and interplanetary conflicts below.


4. Planetary Warfare: Expanding the Battlefield to the Solar System

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110866/4df273b08cbc8cbd3ba3afab1d8c21c12d287d3d.png

Perhaps the most exciting addition is planetary warfare, where battles extend beyond Earth. In Realpolitiks 3, players can now engage in conflicts on other celestial bodies within our solar system, including Mars, the Moon, the Sun, and even the moons of other planets. Each of these environments presents its own challenges, with different resource availability, environmental hazards, and strategic considerations.


 Lunar Battles: The Moon offers a closer-to-home battlefield, where nations can establish military bases or resource-extraction operations. Lunar combat is fast and brutal, requiring swift, decisive actions to control the satellite.
 Martian Warfare: Mars, with its rich resources and strategic importance, will become a new hotspot for conflict. Deploy Martian colonies and military outposts to establish dominance over this red world.
 Solar Conflicts: Yes, even the Sun is a battleground! In Realpolitiks 3, you can build solar power stations or scientific outposts near the Sun, which serve as crucial points for energy and technological research. But be wary — solar flares and extreme radiation can complicate your plans.


Control over other planets also directly influences your technological development, military power, and political leverage on Earth.

The Importance of Strategic Layering

The addition of air, orbital, and planetary warfare introduces a new level of strategic complexity. These layers are interdependent; controlling the skies can enhance ground battles, while orbital dominance can provide crucial intelligence and satellite-based weapons that impact battles on Earth and beyond. The interconnected nature of these systems ensures that no single layer of combat exists in isolation — success in Realpolitiks 3 means mastering them all.

What This Means for You

These new layers of combat make Realpolitiks 3 the most expansive and immersive entry in the series. As a player, you’ll have more freedom to devise complex strategies, whether through dominating the skies, controlling orbital space, or expanding humanity’s reach to other planets. The stakes have never been higher, and the variety of warfare allows for infinite strategic possibilities.

Get ready to lead your nation across land, sky, space, and beyond in the most ambitious Realpolitiks game yet!

Stay tuned for more updates and deep dives into the new features coming to Realpolitiks 3: Earth and Beyond. We also encourage you to share your thoughts and strategies in the comments below, in the Steam Discussions, or better your - join the Realpolitiks HQ Discord server to chat directly with the developers and fellow aspiring world leaders. We can’t wait to see how you conquer the stars!

Happy strategizing!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2298690/Realpolitiks_3_Earth_and_Beyond/

notes.title: Ascend to Power in Realpolitiks 3 – Master the Modern World
notes.content:
Dear World Leaders, Generals, Master Strategists, Politicians, Prime Ministers, Kings, Emperors, and other Rulers!

We are thrilled to invite you to explore the latest installment in our grand strategy series – Realpolitiks 3. This game places you at the helm of a modern state, where your decisions will shape the future of the world. As the creators of this series, we are constantly striving for realism and complexity, offering a true-to-life experience of the challenges faced by contemporary leaders. Realpolitiks 3 offers a whole host of new features for would-be leaders to sink their teeth into - here’s just a brief taster of how this latest sequel will raise your leadership skills to new heights.

Grand Strategy Engine and Cutting-Edge Technology
In Realpolitiks 3, we are excited to introduce a suite of groundbreaking technologies that elevate the game beyond its predecessors. The new Grand Strategy Engine, along with our proprietary Strategy Forge tools and the advanced AI system GS-AIM, mark a significant leap forward in our development capabilities. 

Thanks to the Grand Strategy Engine, players can now enjoy much shorter save and load times, making for a more seamless and immersive gameplay experience. The Strategy Forge tools have empowered our designers to create more intricate and dynamic game systems, ensuring a deeper and more engaging strategy experience. Meanwhile, the GS-AIM provides smarter and more responsive AI, offering a more challenging and realistic opponent in both diplomatic and military engagements. With these innovations, we've not only improved the overall stability and performance of the game but we have also achieved the highest standard in the grand strategy genre.

Good News for the Franchise
These state-of-the-art technologies allow us to do more than just distinguish Realpolitiks 3: Earth and Beyond from the previous installments, however. While we cannot bring all the new features and upgrades to Realpolitiks and Realpolitiks II, working with these new tools does allow us to make improvements to them. We are happy to announce that you can now enjoy the first fruit of this labor: Realpolitiks II has received an update today, fixing a major issue - the dreaded “time-freeze” bug. For more information about that update, please read the patch notes here. 

We are immensely grateful to all the players of our previous games for all your feedback and support throughout the years. Even though we are focused on the new project and using the modern technologies to make the best Realpolitiks game possible, we hope to find more opportunities like this to improve the originals; we are moving the franchise forward with the new installment, but we do not intend to just forget and about its roots.

But without further ado, let’s dive deep into some of the highlights you can expect from Realpolitiks 3: Earth and Beyond when it launches later this year!

New Combat System
In Realpolitiks 3, we've revolutionized the combat system. Units can now move freely across the map, with battles taking place along fronts in various provinces, allowing for a more strategic approach to military management. Air support can now be used to bolster your forces, and new possibilities are introduced with the inclusion of battles in Earth's orbit and on other planets. Prepare for new challenges, as you will now need to manage not only land, naval, and air forces, but also space armies! We've moved away from separate battlefields and micromanagement of units, focusing instead on grand strategic decisions that can determine the fate of entire nations.

The Role of the Head of State, Politicians, and Parties
In this version, the role of the head of state and other key political figures has been significantly expanded. Your leader can gain experience and new skills, becoming a more effective ruler over time. However, beware of character flaws that may impact your governing skills - will you manage a state led by a gambler or a less-than-brilliant leader? You can also hire specialists for your ministries to leverage their abilities and create political dynasties. Choose from 18 new political systems, including anarchy, technocracy, or military junta, and shape your government according to your vision.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110866/e4ee18dc0eb6654a2ef0657225de8dd2757bca90.jpg
Space Exploration and Colonization
Take your ambitions to new heights with the ability to colonize the Moon and other planets in our Solar System. We're bringing back the scope of colonization from the first Realpolitiks game, but in a completely new format. In addition to traditional military operations, you can now explore space, develop new technologies, and establish bases in interplanetary space. Space expansion becomes a key element of your strategy, offering unprecedented opportunities for growth.

New Building System
Provincial development has taken on a new significance in Realpolitiks 3. You can now build multiple structures within a single province, depending on its level of development. Watch as road networks and cities expand, reflecting your progress and strategy. Every investment decision becomes more crucial, with infrastructure development being a key to success.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110866/b53c5a71946a9d61cab156abbdc7ba01409788b4.jpg
New "Way of Life" Mechanic
We have introduced a new mechanic that defines a country's current "Way of Life." This mechanic is not directly related to the current political system or parameters, but rather signifies the long-term attitude and expectations of the population. Points are earned by the head of state and government officials. Politicians now have a new parameter—Ideology, which influences the "Way of Life" by steadily guiding the nation towards certain traits, such as authoritarianism or liberalism. These changes define the long-term development and policies of the state.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110866/e8f0d438cb6d74721e5d59f13165c5e04d8efbc6.jpg
Leader and Political System Customization
At the start of the game, you can choose your political system and customize your initial leader. Will you govern your state with an iron fist as a military dictator, or lead as a democratic ruler with a liberal approach? The choice is yours, and every decision has its consequences.

These are just a few of the numerous changes and new features we have prepared for you in Realpolitiks 3. You will face numerous challenges, engaging gameplay, and strategic decisions that will determine the fate of the world. Join us and see if you can rise to the challenge of managing a modern state on an unprecedented scale. Get ready to step into the world of Realpolitiks 3 – a simulator that will make you feel like a true leader!
